title: Local workspace overrides
description: `.logreq/local.yaml` next to `logreq-workspace.yaml`: settings of one person on one machine. The file is not committed (add `.logreq/` to `.gitignore`). It overrides where a repository of the workspace lies locally (SR-004). Faulty content is reported as a warning and ignored.

repositories.description: Per repository name of the workspace file: where it lies on this machine.

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the main repository (the folder with `logreq-workspace.yaml`). No `~` expansion.
